notes.title: Bug Patch #1
notes.notes:
Our original release was not granting the perfect run or beat the game achievements. This patch fixes that. If you already beat the game and still have your save file, you will be auto-granted these achievements upon starting the game. If you hadn't, well now it's actually possible. Have at it!

Additional Changes:
[list]
[*] Added unused tracks from the Soundtrack to the game
[*] Fixed pause menu flickering at the start of some levels
[*] A couple non-user facing tweaks
[/list]

We really appreciate all the feedback we've been getting. Keep it coming, we'll be doing more patches in the coming weeks.
